halfTime.question: Does your school consider you enrolled at least half-time?
halfTime.help: Your school registrar or student portal may show your enrollment level.

mealPlan.question: Do you live on campus and get more than half of your meals through a college meal plan?

workStudy.question: Were you approved for work-study?
workStudy.help: This can count even if the job has not started yet or is not available.
workStudy.result: You may meet the work-study student exemption.

workHours.question: About how many paid hours do you work each week?
workHours.result: You may meet the work requirement exemption.

nextTerm.question: Do you plan to enroll next term?
nextTerm.resultIfNo: You may meet the exemption for not planning to enroll next term.
